short_description.text: Berechiah — father of Zechariah the prophet (ZEC 1:1).
Abihud — son of Zerubbabel in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:13). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eliakim — son of Abihud in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:13). Of the tribe of Judah.
Azor — son of Eliakim in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:13). Of the tribe of Judah.
Zadok — son of Azor in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Achim — son of Zadok in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eliud — son of Achim in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eleazar — son of Eliud in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Matthan — son of Eleazar in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Jacob — son of Matthan in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Archelaus — son of Herod (MAT 2:22). Of the tribe of Edom.
Gadara is a place named in Scripture (Matt.8.28).
Magadan is a place named in Scripture (Matt.15.39).
